levels.surface: أبو عامر عبد الملك بن عمرو

notes: Branch 1 writes «وعن رجل» as a co-transmitter of عبد الرحمن; the editor gloss naming him is left out.
The phrase «بإسناد يحيى بن سعيد» in branch 2 is not written as a link: it points to branch 1's head, not to a new transmitter.
أبي بكرة is written once after the last «ح», so it is the shared tail.
